name: Necromancer Long March removes March of the Dead's cooldown and gives it a 1 sec cast (#1058)
contract: Long March 704717 is a Necromancer Animation talent (CharacterAdvancement 30238, ClassType 25 = class 23, Tab 61 Animation, TalentEssenceCost 1). Its client description reads 'Removes the cooldown from March of the Dead, but gives it a $/1000;s2 sec cast time.' Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) MiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN) with BasePoints -101 + DieSides 1 = -100; effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) MiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME) with BasePoints 999 + DieSides 1 = 1000. Both use EffectSpellClassMask (0x80000, 0, 0) in SpellFamilyName 29, which matches March of the Dead 707007 (family flags 0x80000, 0, 0; CastingTimeIndex 1 = instant, RecoveryTime 10000 ms, 400 Runic Power, 1500 ms global cooldown). Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns applies SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN to the recovery time and Unit::ModSpellCastTime lets a positive flat cast-time modifier give an instant spell a cast time. So without the talent March of the Dead is instant and goes on a 10 sec cooldown; with it the cast takes 1000 ms, completes, leaves no cooldown and can be cast again as soon as the global cooldown ends.
